description: Free. Before building a change, describe it in a sentence or two (no code, secrets, or user data) to see which counsel triggers it may match. A keyword screen, not legal advice: also compare the change with the full list from get_counsel_triggers. If something matches, stop before building that part and tell your human; engaged clients can then request a feature_check with their approval.

change.description: What the change does, in plain words, e.g. "send users' journal entries to OpenAI to generate weekly insights". No code, secrets, or user data.

name: check_change
title: Check a planned change (free)
